premises.text: Tens of millions of small businesses need branding but cannot afford crowdsourced design and produce low-quality DIY brands instead
premises.evidence_span: Over 80 million small businesses out there want branding, need branding, but can't really afford it

premises.text: Taylor's rule-based learning system studies a business and generates fresh, template-free brand designs
premises.evidence_span: Using thousands of design rules from the simplest color circle to how fonts interact and what industries using what style

premises.text: Customers pay about $50 only when thrilled and receive a full print-ready brand kit plus ongoing asset design
premises.evidence_span: no money exchanges hands until you're completely thrilled with your new design

premises.text: The learning system also produces brand and trend insights from the brands it designs
premises.evidence_span: it can actually understand brand insights, and trend insights, and give that to you

value.text: Small businesses can look as good as Fortune 500 companies with accessible branding
value.evidence_span: they can look as good as any Fortune 500 company with Taylor

causal_links.evidence_span: want branding, need branding, but can't really afford it
put an in-house designer in every business across the world for just 50 bucks
brand insights, and trend insights, and give that to you

notes: Transparent unpaid process, no-templates, and $50 kit folded into one commercial design offer with the learning engine. Market-takeover claim not coded as premise.
